audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for genealogy structure, genesis/birth language, David/Abraham framing, named women, deportation structure, Joseph/Mary betrothal, pneuma hagion, angelic naming, Jesus/Yeshua salvation wordplay, Emmanuel citation, and Joseph's obedience.

verses.restored: A book of the genesis of Jesus Messiah, son of David, son of Abraham.

familiar.text: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

modern.text: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:

original.text: Βίβλος γενέσεως Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ υἱοῦ Δαυὶδ υἱοῦ Ἀβραάμ.

verses.restored: Abraham fathered Isaac, Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.

familiar.text: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

modern.text: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.

original.text: Ἀβραὰμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαάκ, Ἰσαὰκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ, Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar; Perez fathered Hezron, and Hezron fathered Ram.

familiar.text: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

modern.text: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.

original.text: Ἰούδας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φαρὲς καὶ τὸν Ζάρα ἐκ τῆς Θαμάρ, Φαρὲς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑσρώμ, Ἑσρὼμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀράμ,

verses.restored: Ram fathered Amminadab, Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon.

familiar.text: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

modern.text: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.

original.text: Ἀρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμιναδάβ, Ἀμιναδὰβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναασσών, Ναασσὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλμών,

verses.restored: Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab, Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth, and Obed fathered Jesse.

familiar.text: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

modern.text: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,

original.text: Σαλμὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Βόες ἐκ τῆς Ῥαχάβ, Βόες⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Ἰωβὴδ ἐκ τῆς Ῥούθ, Ἰωβὴδ⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεσσαί,

verses.restored: Jesse fathered David the king. David fathered Solomon by the wife of Uriah.

familiar.text: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

modern.text: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,

original.text: Ἰεσσαὶ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Δαυὶδ τὸν βασιλέα. Δαυὶδ ⸀δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σολομῶνα ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Οὐρίου,

verses.restored: Solomon fathered Rehoboam, Rehoboam fathered Abijah, and Abijah fathered Asaph/Asa.

familiar.text: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

modern.text: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.

original.text: Σολομὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ῥοβοάμ, Ῥοβοὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιά, Ἀβιὰ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Ἀσάφ,

verses.restored: Asaph/Asa fathered Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat fathered Joram, and Joram fathered Uzziah.

familiar.text: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

modern.text: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.

original.text: Ἀσὰφ⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ, Ἰωσαφὰτ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωράμ, Ἰωρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ὀζίαν,

verses.restored: Uzziah fathered Jotham, Jotham fathered Ahaz, and Ahaz fathered Hezekiah.

familiar.text: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

modern.text: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.

original.text: Ὀζίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωαθάμ, Ἰωαθὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχάζ, Ἀχὰζ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑζεκίαν,

verses.restored: Hezekiah fathered Manasseh, Manasseh fathered Amos/Amon, and Amos/Amon fathered Josiah.

familiar.text: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

modern.text: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,

original.text: Ἑζεκίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μανασσῆ, Μανασσῆς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Ἀμώς, Ἀμὼς⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσίαν,

verses.restored: Josiah fathered Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the deportation to Babylon.

familiar.text: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

modern.text: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

original.text: Ἰωσίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεχονίαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος.

verses.restored: After the deportation to Babylon, Jeconiah fathered Shealtiel, and Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.

familiar.text: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

modern.text: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,

original.text: Μετὰ δὲ τὴν μετοικεσίαν Βαβυλῶνος Ἰεχονίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλαθιήλ, Σαλαθιὴλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ζοροβαβέλ,

verses.restored: Zerubbabel fathered Abiud, Abiud fathered Eliakim, and Eliakim fathered Azor.

familiar.text: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

modern.text: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.

original.text: Ζοροβαβὲλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιούδ, Ἀβιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιακίμ, Ἐλιακὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζώρ,

verses.restored: Azor fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Achim, and Achim fathered Eliud.

familiar.text: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

modern.text: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.

original.text: Ἀζὼρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, Σαδὼκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχίμ, Ἀχὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιούδ,

verses.restored: Eliud fathered Eleazar, Eleazar fathered Matthan, and Matthan fathered Jacob.

familiar.text: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

modern.text: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,

original.text: Ἐλιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλεάζαρ, Ἐλεάζαρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ματθάν, Ματθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ,

verses.restored: Jacob fathered Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom Jesus was born, the one called Messiah.

familiar.text: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

modern.text: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

original.text: Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἄνδρα Μαρίας, ἐξ ἧς ἐγεννήθη Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος χριστός.

verses.restored: So all the generations from Abraham to David were fourteen generations, from David to the deportation to Babylon fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon to the Messiah fourteen generations.

familiar.text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

modern.text: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ. The Birth of Jesus (Isaiah 7:10–16; Luke 2:1–7)

original.text: Πᾶσαι οὖν αἱ γενεαὶ ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἕως Δαυὶδ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ Δαυὶδ ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος ἕως τοῦ χριστοῦ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες.

verses.restored: The genesis/birth of Jesus Messiah was this way: his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, but before they came together she was found to be carrying in the womb from holy Spirit.

familiar.text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

modern.text: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.

original.text: Τοῦ δὲ ⸀Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ ἡ ⸀γένεσις οὕτως ἦν. ⸀μνηστευθείσης τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μαρίας τῷ Ἰωσήφ, πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εὑρέθη ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα ἐκ πνεύματος ἁγίου.

verses.restored: Joseph her husband, being just and not wanting to expose her publicly, intended to release her quietly.

familiar.text: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

modern.text: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.

original.text: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, δίκαιος ὢν καὶ μὴ θέλων αὐτὴν ⸀δειγματίσαι, ἐβουλήθη λάθρᾳ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν.

verses.restored: As he considered these things, look, a messenger of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph son of David, do not fear to take Mary your wife, for what has been generated in her is from holy Spirit.

familiar.text: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

modern.text: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.

original.text: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐνθυμηθέντος ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου κατʼ ὄναρ ἐφάνη αὐτῷ λέγων· Ἰωσὴφ υἱὸς Δαυίδ, μὴ φοβηθῇς παραλαβεῖν ⸀Μαρίαν τὴν γυναῖκά σου, τὸ γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ γεννηθὲν ἐκ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἁγίου·

verses.restored: She will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus/Yeshua, for he will save his people from their sins.

familiar.text: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

modern.text: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”

original.text: τέξεται δὲ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν, αὐτὸς γὰρ σώσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: All this happened so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet might be fulfilled, saying:

familiar.text: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

modern.text: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

original.text: τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ⸀ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·

verses.restored: Look, the virgin/young woman will carry in the womb and will bear a son, and they will call his name Emmanuel, which is translated, God with us.

familiar.text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

modern.text: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us” ).

original.text: Ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ καλέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ· ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Μεθʼ ἡμῶν ὁ θεός.

verses.restored: Joseph rose from sleep and did as the messenger of the Lord commanded him; he took his wife.

familiar.text: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

modern.text: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and embraced Mary as his wife.

original.text: ⸀ἐγερθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἐποίησεν ὡς προσέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ παρέλαβεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ·

verses.restored: But he did not know her until she had borne a son, and he called his name Jesus/Yeshua.

familiar.text: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

modern.text: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.

original.text: καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν αὐτὴν ἕως οὗ ἔτεκεν ⸀υἱόν· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.
